after: A transition marks a screen update as less urgent. `useTransition` gives you `isPending`, which reports unfinished transition work, and `startTransition`, which marks the update.
The function passed to startTransition runs immediately. State updates made directly inside it are marked as transitions. React can prioritize other updates while preparing that screen.
A transition is not a timer. It does not promise a fixed delay or a faster calculation. It tells React which rendering work can be treated as less urgent.
Keep immediate selection feedback outside the transition. A text input's current value must also update immediately rather than through a transition.
